mapper.select: SELECT id AS batch_participant_id, health_examination_participant_id AS participant_id, participant_code_snapshot AS participant_code, department_snapshot AS department_name, job_title_snapshot, occupation_snapshot AS occupation, administrative_snapshot_json, status, created_at FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants WHERE health_examination_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
